methods.name: Single-subject global morphometry
methods.purpose: Project global method: BrainSegVol (or positive brainmask support volume, disclosed separately) is distinct from eTIV. Bilateral WhiteSurfArea is summed; MeanThickness is weighted by those hemisphere areas. Optional full-pial area / 3D convex-hull area is computed as a ratio of bilateral sums, not local gyrification. Correct verified rescale k by powers 1/2/3; unknown history leaves physical outputs empty. Whole-brain species-mean ratios require scale and definition compatibility, not regional homology.
